Generated Narrative: ValueSet VS-CoreUploadSet

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Import all the codes that are contained in the intersection of 健康檢查核心檢驗項目值集（主管機關最小上傳集之檢驗子集）
  • Import all the codes that are contained in the intersection of 職業健檢生命徵象項目值集
  • Include these codes as defined in http://loinc.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)
    CodeDisplay
    72166-2Tobacco smoking status
    64218-1How many cigarettes do you smoke per day now [PhenX]
    63632-4About how long has it been since you completely quit smoking cigarettes [TUS-CPS]
  • Include these codes as defined in http://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)

    698188003Chews betel quid

description: 群組值集：組合 Core 之檢驗子集（VS-CoreDataset）、生理量測（VS-TWHAVitalSigns）與社會史碼，具體化主管機關（國健署）制定之最小共通上傳集（原案 16 主項／21 列，對標 USCDI regulator-defined minimum）。僅供文件與完整度／覆蓋矩陣機器核對，不作 Observation.code 綁定。嚼檳量／嚼檳月數屬本地 Extension（ext-betelnut-quantity），無國際碼，於文件註記。
